lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: High-luminance circular spots are arranged in approximately six visible longitudinal rows following the body curvature posterior to the gill slits, forming a semi-regular 2D grid.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Diffuse vertical bands of elevated pixel intensity intersect the longitudinal rows, with primary high-luminance blobs localized at these intersection points to form a checkerboard-like grid of anchor nodes.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: Three distinct longitudinal carinae run horizontally across the upper flank, characterized by a sharp vertical gradient with high-intensity highlights on the dorsal-facing edges and shadowed lower boundaries.

other_distinctive_markers: Presence of multiple commensal Echeneidae (remoras) attached to the ventral and lateral surfaces near the base of the pectoral fin.
